entry.summary: An electronic travel authorisation (eTA) before flying to Canada. Not needed when arriving by land or sea.
entry.pre_arrival: Apply for the eTA through Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada only.
entry.other: A criminal record, including a drink-driving conviction, can bar entry. Children travelling without both parents should carry a consent letter.

meetings.route: eTA (by air) as a business visitor
meetings.detail: Meetings are a listed business visitor activity, if your income and main business stay outside Canada.

conference.route: eTA (by air) as a business visitor
conference.detail: Conferences, conventions and trade fairs are listed.

unpaid-speaking.route: eTA plus the work-permit exemption (public speakers)
unpaid-speaking.detail: Public speakers are listed among people who can work without a permit, with conditions.
unpaid-speaking.next: Check the exemption's conditions on IRCC's page for that occupation before travel.

paid-speaking.route: eTA plus the work-permit exemption (public speakers)
paid-speaking.detail: Public speakers are exempt with conditions; check them for paid engagements.
paid-speaking.next: Check the exemption's conditions on IRCC's page for that occupation before travel.

book-launch.route: eTA plus the work-permit exemption (public speakers) or business visitor
book-launch.detail: A reading or talk may fit the public-speaker exemption; selling directly is a separate question.
book-launch.next: Check the exemption's conditions on IRCC's page for that occupation before travel.

ai-teaching.route: Work permit, unless an exemption fits
ai-teaching.detail: Production or hands-on work in Canada needs a work permit.
ai-teaching.next: Ask IRCC or an authorised representative.

remote-work.route: Not stated on the pages read
remote-work.detail: Business visitors keep their main income outside Canada; remote work for an overseas employer isn't addressed directly.

entrepreneur.route: eTA (by air) as a business visitor
entrepreneur.detail: Exploring and meeting fit a business visit; running a business in Canada needs a work permit or another program.

trade.route: eTA (by air) as a business visitor
trade.detail: Trade fairs and buying or selling for a foreign company are business visits.

artist.route: eTA plus the work-permit exemption (performing artists)
artist.detail: Performing artists are listed among those exempt from a work permit, with conditions.
artist.next: Check the exemption's conditions on IRCC's page for that occupation before travel.

mixed-mission.detail: Business visitor and exemptions cover different parts.

filming.detail: Filming isn't listed among the exemptions read; location permits are separate.
filming.next: Ask IRCC, and the province's film office.

research.route: eTA plus the work-permit exemption (short-term researchers)
research.detail: Short-term researchers are listed among those exempt, with conditions.
research.next: Check the exemption's conditions on IRCC's page for that occupation before travel.

volunteering.detail: Volunteering isn't addressed on the pages read.

laws.rule: The recreational use of marijuana (Cannabis) is subject to local laws and regulations. It's illegal to transport marijuana (Cannabis) across Canada's international borders (including the United States), even if you are entering or leaving the country. If you break the law, you can receive criminal penalties, including jail time. Make sure you know the local cannabis laws about: legal age possession purchase sharing impairment production Local health authorities have reported illegal drugs may be mixed with more potent substances that can lead to health issues including overdose and death.
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: Check the local legal drinking age before buying or drinking alcohol. The legal age varies across the country.
laws.heading: Alcohol

laws.rule: Seek legal advice before entering into a surrogacy arrangement.
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: To drive in Canada, you may need: an International Driving Permit (IDP) and a valid Australian licence Get an IDP before you leave Australia. You can drive for up to one year with an IDP and your Australian licence. After that, you'll need a local driver's licence. Requirements may vary in different provinces and states. For details see Driving in Canada.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The local currency is the Canadian Dollar (CAD). You can change Australian dollars at commercial banks and exchange bureaus. Declare all amounts over CAD$10,000. This covers all forms of currency, not only cash. Credit and debit cards are widely accepted.

It's illegal to transport marijuana (Cannabis) across Canada's international borders (including the United States), even if you are entering or leaving the country.

Make sure you know the local cannabis laws about: legal age possession purchase sharing impairment production Local health authorities have reported illegal drugs may be mixed with more potent substances that can lead to health issues including overdose and death.
Check the local legal drinking age before buying or drinking alcohol.

From 5 January 2022, a Health Canada class exemption let practitioners with a Special Access Program authorisation prescribe and administer psilocybin for emergency treatment. Health Canada's page says the exemption ends when new Controlled Substances Regulations take effect on 1 October 2026; the rules after that date weren't checked.
MDMA follows the same Special Access Program route as psilocybin, under the same class exemption and end date.
